prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1030; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in while turning left in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the facts of what happened. My name is on the claim form.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving and what you were doing when the collision occurred?

A: I was heading toward a shopping center on a main road in the middle of the afternoon. I had my turn signal on and was waiting to turn left across the oncoming lanes.

Q: Were you stopped or moving when you began the turn?

A: I was moving slowly. I checked both ways, saw the other car was a fair distance off, and started through the turn. Then the other vehicle came through the intersection much faster than I expected and struck the passenger side of my car.

Q: Did you have any warning before the impact?

A: Just a split second. I tried to brake, but there wasn't time to avoid it.

Q: Did you feel any injury right after the collision?

A: My neck felt stiff almost immediately, and by that evening my lower back was sore. I didn't think much of it at first, but it's gotten worse over the past few days.

Q: Have you sought medical attention for those symptoms?

A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic and was told I had a neck and back strain. I've been given exercises and a prescription for pain relief.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been careful about following the treatment plan and I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
